description: Runtime configuration for the intake workstream. Config over code (CLAUDE.md): emails, SLAs, token lifetimes and vocabulary choices live here, never as literals in code. Every value may be overridden by the environment variable named in env_overrides.

api.note: Browsers block the intake screens from calling the API cross-origin unless the API says which origins are allowed. Applied by intake/backend/app.py only; running backend.app.main:app directly is unaffected. Set INTAKE_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (comma-separated) per environment - never '*', which would let any site call the API with a user's session.

email.note: The 'outbox' adapter writes messages to a local gitignored file and sends nothing. A real provider is a separate adapter behind the same port; no provider is configured in v1.

general.reason: The mapping defines site-type values for the film overlay only. General-overlay values are free text pending sign-off rather than invented.

provisional_vocabularies.note: Founder-approved Phase B decision: these two fields have no controlled vocabulary anywhere in reference-data or legacy-schemas, so they ship as free text flagged provisional rather than with invented values (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

operational_status.reason: No controlled vocabulary for operational_status exists in the methodology workbooks or the legacy audit_setup schema.

fiscal_year_basis.reason: No controlled vocabulary for fiscal_year_basis exists in the methodology workbooks or the legacy audit_setup schema.
